acceptance_criteria: WHEN multiple primary groups exist THEN selected non-redeemable number is chosen before OCR confusion and no-card false negative; WHEN a group has failed strategy memory THEN it is skipped for this Optimization Run Session; WHEN a group improves but is not accepted THEN one follow-up attempt is allowed; ref: docs/prd/focused-feedback-attempts.md:56
